description: This PHP file defines the HtmlErrorRenderer class within the Slim framework, responsible for rendering HTML representations of errors and exceptions, including detailed debugging information when enabled.

classes.name: HtmlErrorRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class that generates HTML error pages for the Slim framework, displaying error details or user-friendly messages based on configuration.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the error and returns an HTML string representing the error page, optionally including detailed exception info.

methods.name: renderExceptionFragment
methods.description: Generates the HTML fragment that displays detailed information about a throwable exception.

methods.name: renderHtmlBody
methods.description: Constructs and returns a complete HTML document with a given title and body content.
